items.title: Prom Teens
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
It's dance time! Dress up in these prom teen attires and get ready to party!

+ 10 prom fashion-inspired skins!
+ Prom ready!

items.title: Dynamite Valley
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Zander Studios presents: Dynamite Valley! The town has been taken over by scorpions! Fight back with the vast array of different dynamite! Get ready to have some explosive fun!

- Different types of dynamite!
- Many quests to complete!
- Economy system!
- Work your way up to the Nuclear Mining Device!
- Licensed by Zander Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Cyberpunk Parkour
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Parkour your way through 4 unique challenging levels in a cyberpunk city! Test your parkour mastery skills today! Can you beat them all?

- Cyberpunk themed
- Giant map
- Licensed by 5 Frame Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Bone Armor
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description: They believe the bones of their ancestors contain great power. They wear them as a tribute and to absorb the essence of their foes.

items.title: Betas
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description: If you have a problem, if no one else can help, and if you can find them... Maybe you can hire... The Betas!

items.title: Cute Furniture
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Decorate your world with CUTE FURNITURE! 

+ 540 Furniture Options!
+ Multiple Color Variants!
+ Cute & Colorful Furniture Tools!
+ Super Adorable Pets!

items.title: Lucky Block++
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Choose from 11 LUCKY BLOCKS! Get a chance to create your own LUCKY BLOCK by giving us your suggestions! Test your luck on a LARGE FACTORY! Play in SURVIVAL and TROLL your friends in this world! Super FUN and UNIQUE events!

+ 380+ LUCKY & UNLUCKY DROPS!
+ PRINCESS & PRINCE!
+ TNT, CLASSIC, & RAINBOW!
+ NOOB, BASE, & SCARY!
+ CUTE, GIANT, & ASTRAL!

items.title: Luna Heads
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: This sun and moon skin pack is lunar shine the infinite world, all the way to the end. Protect and defend your realm to become the best character Minecraft has ever seen!

items.title: Trendy Neko Teens
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Both cool and cute neko skins await you in this skin pack! Everyone will admire your cuteness and they won't be able to take their eyes off you!

+ 12 neko skins
+ 2 FREE skins!
+ Perfect for roleplay
+ Perfect for teens

items.title: Parkour Space Games
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Get your running shoes ready again for this fun and competitive parkour map!

Challenge your friends on a variety of exciting space-themed courses!

- 7 easy levels
- 9 hard levels
- Point system
- Resetting courses
- Speed + Jump boost options

See if you can finish all the tracks, get the most points and become a legend!

items.title: Fantasy Village
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: A village full of magic and wonderful secrets, explore all of them! Collect loot and create your own farm in this cute neighborhood.

items.title: Grid Parkour Biomes
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Grid Parkour Biomes is the perfect place for anyone who wants to practice their parkour or challenge among friends! Can you beat all 100 courses that range in difficulty from easy to hard? 

- 100 levels 
- Many forms of parkour
- 16 themes
- Range of difficulty

items.title: Glitches
items.creator: Canada Web Developer
items.description:
Something, somewhere went wrong and now sky blocky rifts are appearing and glitches in Minecraft are happening! Now these horrors are among us and you have to be skilled or lucky to survive.


10 HD skins including:

- 1 free
- 9 glitch skins

1 Exclusive skin by: Dannny0117

Created and Published by: Dannny0117 + Canada Web Developer.

items.title: BriannaPlayz Epic Anime Teens
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
20 anime skins? Now, that’s epic! Dress up in formal school outfits, or go casual in unique teen outfits.

- 1 free Brianna skin
- 20 total skins
- Perfect for roleplay

By BriannaPlayz & CinemaCraft

items.title: PrestonPlayz Monster Merch
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
Blend in among Preston and his creepy monster crew! Pick from 17 skins, like goblins, ogres, and werewolves. These skins are sure to scare your friends!

- 1 free Preston skin
- 17 total skins

By PrestonPlayz & CinemaCraft

items.title: BriannaPlayz Kawaii Mobs
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
Brianna’s kawaii mobs are ready for action! From a blushing pig, to a cute creeper. Pick from any of these 14 very cute skins for your next adventure!

- 1 free Brianna skin
- 14 total skins

By BriannaPlayz & CinemaCraft

items.title: BriannaPlayz Impostor Teens
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
Enter space with these impostor teens! Brianna brings you 19 stylish skins perfect for any occasion. Just be aware, there may be an impostor among us!

- 1 free Brianna skin
- 19 total skins
- Teen skins with accessories

By BriannaPlayz & CinemaCraft

items.title: Animal Hoodies
items.creator: Geeky Pixels
items.description:
Impress your friends with these super cool and cute animal hoodies. Wear one and see which animals you could befriend.

- Ten unique hoodies
- Cuteness overload included

items.title: Elementals HD
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: The powers of nature are now in your hands! Wear these skins and harness the power of the elemental golems!

items.title: Sailors Rush
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Aye aye, sailors are exploring the seas to find untraced treasures and capture islands. You sure don't want to mess with them but you can be part of their expedition!

- 21 sailor skins
+ 1 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Sleepy Sheepies
items.creator: Geeky Pixels
items.description:
Count all 80 of these Sleepy Sheepies to help you get to get to the land of nod! 1... 2... 3... 4... zZzZzZzZzZzZzZzZzZzZzZz

- 5 unique skins in all 16 colours
- 80 skins in total

items.title: Millionaire Resort
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Move into this GIANT mansion and live your life as best as possible on a private island! Get all the world's luxuries like an outdoor pool, an indoor pool, a private helicopter, and a private yacht. Did I mention it's a private island?

+ Many unique rooms!
+ Beautiful island with a great view to the world!

- By Orbital Studios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Craftable Base
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Craft an underground base in a fraction of the time! Design the base your way with 25 new crafting recipes. You decide where each room goes. The garage comes with cars you can drive. The pet room has animals that do tricks.
- 23 cells to build in
- 23 modular rooms to craft
- 5 skins
- Survival, roleplay, or multiplayer fun

Build what you want and where you want it!

items.title: Sky Rails
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Ride trains through a futuristic city in the sky. Each biome-themed island is connected by twisting train tacks. Explore each island and discover helicopters, planes, police cars, trucks, motorcycles, and more.
- 2 new trains that work like minecarts
- 14 vehicles
- 5 aircraft
- 5 skins
- Survival, roleplay, or multiplayer fun

Build more sky rails and expand the city!
